हुण्ड् हुण्ड्, cl. 1. A. हुण्डते, &c., to col-
lect, accumulate; to select, choose, take,
accept (= rt. भुण्ड्, q. v.).

हुण्ड, अस्, m. a tiger; a village hog; a block-
head; a demon, imp; a ram.

हुण्डिका हुण्डिका, f. (Pers. هندي), a bill
of exchange, bond; assignment, order (given for the
maintenance of soldiers).

हूण हूण, अस्, m. a barbarian, Hun; N.
of a district; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people (living in
Bhārata-varṣa).
